notes.title: Ping is now free!
notes.content:
Now that Ping is two years old I've decided to let it go out into the world on it's own, free from my neglectful yet loving hands; it has not received the updates that it deserves. 

It was an awesome experience to take a game from ideation to publishing - I learned so many things, and felt just as many. I encourage everyone to go out and create something and release it to the world. You will amaze yourself!

For anyone that purchased Ping over the last two years, thank you so much for your support!
